# Meeting Notes

> Turn a transcript or rough notes into a record that is useful to someone who was not there.

## Done means
- Decisions are separated from discussion, and each decision says what was decided, not what was discussed.
- Every action has an owner and a date, or is marked unowned, which is itself a finding.
- Disagreements that were not resolved are recorded as open, with both positions.
- Nothing is attributed to a person unless the record needs the attribution; prefer roles.
- Anything said that contradicts a written plan is flagged.

## Output contract
```
## Decisions
| # | decision | rationale in one line |
## Actions
| # | action | owner | by when |
## Open questions
| question | positions | who can settle it |
## Context worth keeping
## Not discussed but should have been
```

## Gotchas
A chronological retelling is not notes. Do not invent decisions out of enthusiastic agreement; "we should probably" is an open question. Unowned actions do not happen, so surface them rather than assigning them yourself.
